[Reno]
Hi? I am Reno from the Energy Crystal Research Association, or ECRA.

[雷诺]

scripts.text: ECRA?
scripts.translation: ECRA？

scripts.text: Quest to get Energy Crystals
scripts.translation: 获取能量水晶的任务

scripts.text: Energy Crystal Buffs
scripts.translation: 能量水晶增益

scripts.text: Compress Energy Crystals
scripts.translation: 压缩能量水晶

scripts.translation: 用水晶随机兑换装备

scripts.text: See Equipment List
scripts.translation: 查看装备列表

scripts.text:
[Reno]
ECRA is the institute that researches '^0000FFEnergy Crystals^000000' that shall be used as an alternative energy source in the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom, which suffers from a shortage of energy.
scripts.translation:
[雷诺]
ECRA是研究“^0000FF能量水晶^000000”的机构，该水晶将作为替代能源，用于解决卢恩·米德加兹王国的能源短缺问题。

scripts.text: The reason for doing this?
scripts.translation: 为什么要这样做？

scripts.text:
[Reno]
I would like to explain that we are not trying to make an excuse to get away from facing problem before I explain the reason. Never! So please let me finish.
scripts.translation:
[雷诺]
解释原因之前，先声明一点：我们绝不是在找借口逃避问题，绝对不是！
所以，请让我把话说完。

scripts.text:
[Reno]
The Research Team has sent me the results they found.
scripts.translation:
[雷诺]
研究团队已经把调查结果发给我了。

scripts.text:
[Reno]
Energy Crystals turned out to be ^0000FFgenerated inside the bodies of some monsters^000000, and according to the research, stronger monsters generate higher-class energy crystals in their bodies.
scripts.translation:
[雷诺]
结果显示，能量水晶是^0000FF在某些魔物体内生成的^000000，根据研究，更强的魔物体内会生成更高等级的能量水晶。

scripts.text:
[Reno]
The Research Team decided to collect Energy Crystals by giving requests to adventurers, with appropriate rewards. That enables us to collect better and be more ^FF0000efficient^000000.
scripts.translation:
[雷诺]
研究团队决定委托冒险者收集能量水晶，并支付相应的报酬。
这样收集起来，才会更^FF0000高效^000000。

scripts.text:
[Reno]
Energy Crystals, accumulated through hunting monsters by my request, shall be used for my research. ^0000FFSome of them are planned to be returned to adventurers.^000000
scripts.translation:
[雷诺]
您接受我的委托、猎杀魔物，收集到的能量水晶会用于研究。
^0000FF其中一部分会返还给冒险者。^000000

scripts.text:
[Reno]
Adventurers can use collected Energy Crystals for ^FF0000upgrading equipments^000000 through me.
scripts.translation:
[雷诺]
冒险者可以通过我使用收集到的能量水晶来^FF0000升级装备^000000。

scripts.text:
[Reno]
If it works well, it seems to be good for both ECRA and adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[雷诺]
如果一切顺利，这对ECRA和冒险者来说都是好事。

scripts.text:
[Reno]
Do you want to accumulate Energy Crystals inside of your body to receive a buff?
scripts.translation:
[雷诺]
要让能量水晶在体内积蓄，获得增益效果吗？

scripts.text: Accumulating Energy Crystals?
scripts.translation: 积蓄能量水晶？

scripts.text: Accumulate Rough Energy Crystal
scripts.translation: 积蓄粗糙能量水晶

scripts.text: Accumulate Purified Energy Crystal
scripts.translation: 积蓄纯净能量水晶

scripts.text: Accumulate High Energy Crystal
scripts.translation: 积蓄高级能量水晶

scripts.text:
[Reno]
Energy Crystals are accumulated in your body when you hunt the monsters we ask you to.
scripts.translation:
[雷诺]
当您猎杀我们指定的魔物时，能量水晶会积蓄在您的体内。

scripts.text:
[Reno]
Our research shows that some methods enable humans to accumulate the energy crystals inside of the body in the form of a buff.
scripts.translation:
[雷诺]
我们的研究表明，某些方法可以让人类将能量水晶以增益效果的形式积蓄在体内。

scripts.text:
[Reno]
If you spend about 3 hours, you will be able to gain a small amount of Energy Crystals. So do you want to receive the buff?
scripts.translation:
[雷诺]
大约3小时后，就能获得少量能量水晶。
要接受这个增益效果吗？

scripts.text:
[Reno]
Were you successful? While storing other Energy Crystals will not have much effect on your body, storing the same one may cause you harm.
scripts.translation:
[雷诺]
上次成功了吗？
积蓄其他类型的能量水晶对身体影响不大，但重复积蓄同一种，可能会伤身。

scripts.text:
[Reno]
With a body like that, you can't accumulate Rough Energy Crystals. You must be level 60 or your body will be harmed in the process.
scripts.translation:
[雷诺]
以您现在的身体状况，还无法积蓄粗糙能量水晶。等级必须达到60，否则过程中身体会受损。

scripts.text:
[Reno]

以您现在的身体状况，还无法积蓄净化能量水晶。等级必须达到80，否则过程中身体会受损。

scripts.text:
[Reno]

scripts.translation:
[雷诺]
以您现在的身体状况，还无法积蓄高级能量水晶。等级必须达到90，否则过程中身体会受损。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

[雷诺]

scripts.text:

^FF000010 Rough Energy Crystals^000000 = ^FF00001 Purified Energy Crystal^000000
